messages:
lina: FYI — OrionPay (enterprise payments) asked for a 45% off list for a 6-month POC. They say conversion to a 12-month committed Dedicated plan is very likely if we hit p50 <120ms and provide SOC2 + EU data residency. Also requesting a one-time migration credit to cover integration costs.

omar: Wow 45% is steep. Whats the ACV if they convert?

lina: If they convert to Dedicated: estimated committed spend ~€620k/year. POC expected rev (at proposed discount) ~€35k for 6 months. They emphasized tight margins.

ben-cfo: From finance side, sliding-scale: up to 20% — sales approval; 21-35% needs CRO thumbs-up; anything >35% requires CFO approval AND a documented conversion clause + PS credit formalized. Need lifetime value calc to justify.

paul-dealdesk: We can offer structured options:
- Option 1: 30% off during 6mo POC + signed binding conversion clause to 12mo at 15% ongoing. No migration credit.
- Option 2: 40% off for 6mo + one-time migration credit (cap €25k) as a PS credit, timeboxed; requires CFO approval for the 40% list concession.
- Option 3: 45% off for 6mo only if they sign 12mo up-front (pre-signed commit) and accept a shorter trial window. This moves risk to customer but gets the discount.

kevin-sre: On infra: to meet p50 <120ms for their profile (avg 900 tokens/request, 400 token responses, 150 concurrent streams, bursts to 3k qps) we'd recommend 3 x A100-80GB equivalent in EU region with autoscale to +2 nodes for bursts. EU-only deployment increases lead time by ~10 business days and ~8-12% cost uplift.

lina: They specifically asked for EU-only data handling. Thats non-negotiable.

eva-security: SOC2 and SSO (SAML/Okta) supported. We can provide EU data residency via Private deployment in EU region, but must add a regional addendum to the MSA. Legal will need to review. Also flagged: they asked for DPIA info and encryption-at-rest proof. I can attach the certs.

omar: Timeline sensitivity — customer wants a yes/no by Wednesday to align with their board review. Can we fast-track approvals?

paul-dealdesk: I will draft a one-page approval memo with the three options and projected math. Attachments: ACV calc, POC revenue, infra cost delta (EU premium), PS credit cap, and security attestation. If option 2 or 3 chosen we need CFO sign-off.

ben-cfo: If they want 45% (option 3) we need the signed 12mo commit upfront or an escrowed payment fixture. Otherwise not approving. For 40% (option 2) I can review if PS credit is structured as non-recurring and capped; need final ARR projection and churn assumption.

infra-bot: sandbox cluster provisioned: sandbox-orionpay-eu-01 (expires in 5 days). Temporary token created: token_XXXX (priv).

kevin-sre: I'll run a perf harness tomorrow on the sandbox. Sample POST for perf harness:
```
curl -s -X POST https://sandbox.redwood.example/v1/generate \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer token_XXXX" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"model":"opt-66b-quant","prompt":"<batch>","max_tokens":400}'
```

lina: Great — please share perf numbers as soon as available. If perf meets target, we'll use that as the conversion milestone in the memo.

paul-dealdesk: Drafting now. Will ping legal for the EU addendum and security attestation. Expect memo in ~3 hours.

lina: Pushed the RFP and integration notes to the thread DM to Paul.

ben-cfo: One more ask: if we approve a material concession, add a rollback clause in case usage falls below an agreed threshold after conversion (e.g., <60% projected usage for 2 consecutive months). Finance needs protection.

paul-dealdesk: Noted. Will include rollback and PS credit caps.

lina: Thanks team. I'm holding customer for a formal response until memo is ready. Will update once we have the perf run and the memo. :sparkles:
